about.title: About Us
storyParagraphs: DieselParts was founded in 2010 and has since become one of the leading suppliers of spare parts for mining and construction machinery.
Today we supply OEM-quality parts for CAT, Komatsu, Volvo, Hitachi, JCB, Hyundai, and Doosan machinery to dealers and companies across dozens of countries.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: We do more than sell parts — we provide the technical support that keeps your machinery running.

items.title: Part selection
items.description: We identify the right part from your machine model, OEM number, or serial number.

items.title: Diagnostics
items.description: We test engine, hydraulic, and transmission assemblies on modern equipment.

items.title: Installation
items.description: Our experienced technicians fit and calibrate the parts you buy.

items.title: Warranty service
items.description: Every part is covered. If a defect appears within the warranty period, we replace it free of charge.

items.title: Consultation
items.description: Our specialists answer technical questions by phone or on Telegram.

items.title: Delivery
items.description: We ship parts across Uzbekistan and to international destinations.

payment.title: Payment
payment.subtitle: Pay the way that suits you — every option is available for both individuals and companies.

methods.title: Cash
methods.description: Pay in cash at our sales point or on delivery of the part.

methods.title: Bank card
methods.description: UzCard, Humo, and Visa cards are accepted through our terminal.

methods.title: Click
methods.description: Online payment via the Click app — confirmed within seconds.

methods.title: Payme
methods.description: Payment through Payme, with the receipt saved automatically in the app.

methods.title: Bank transfer
methods.description: Contract-based transfer for companies. We work with VAT.

methods.title: Invoice
methods.description: We supply all accounting paperwork — invoice and delivery note included.

payment.note: Payments from companies are handled through a contract and an invoice. For large orders we are happy to discuss payment in instalments.

faq.question: Is prepayment required?
faq.answer: Parts in stock can be paid for on delivery. Parts brought in to order require a 50% prepayment.

faq.question: How do I pay as a company?
faq.answer: Send us your company details — we prepare the contract and invoice, and you pay by bank transfer.

faq.question: Do I get a refund if the part does not fit?
faq.answer: Yes. An uninstalled part in resalable condition can be returned within 14 days for a full refund.

faq.question: Do you accept payments from abroad?
faq.answer: Yes, international customers can pay in foreign currency by bank transfer. Contact us for details.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.subtitle: Getting the part to you fast matters — every day of downtime is a loss. That is why we take logistics seriously.

items.title: Within Tashkent
items.description: Courier delivery across the city within one working day.

items.title: To the regions
items.description: To every region of Uzbekistan by freight partners in 2-4 days.

items.title: Air freight
items.description: For urgent cases a part can be flown in on the fastest available route.

items.title: International routes
items.description: Export to CIS countries and beyond, customs paperwork included.

items.title: Warehouse pickup
items.description: If you prefer to collect the order yourself, we will send you the warehouse address.

items.title: Lead times
items.description: Parts in stock ship the same day. Parts brought in to order take 7-21 days.

delivery.note: Delivery cost depends on weight, volume, and destination. Your manager confirms the exact amount when the order is placed.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.subtitle: We offer dedicated terms for dealers, service centres, and large equipment fleets.

items.title: Dealership
items.description: Become an official dealer in your region, with marketing support and exclusive terms.

items.title: Wholesale pricing
items.description: Tiered discounts for partners who order regularly.

items.title: Service centres
items.description: Priority delivery and deferred payment options for repair workshops.

items.title: Reserved stock
items.description: For long-term partners we keep the most-used parts reserved in our warehouse.

items.title: Quality guarantee
items.description: Every part meets OEM standards and comes with certification.

items.title: Growing together
items.description: We advise on market analysis and on widening your product range.
